others.spellCheckDesc: Yambitsani kuyang'ana kalembedwe ka ulusi wanu.
others.resetFactoryDesc: Bwezerani pulogalamuyo kuti ikhale momwe idayambira, kufufuta mitundu yonse ndi mbiri yochezera. Izi sizingasinthe ndipo zimalimbikitsidwa pokhapokha ngati pulogalamuyo yawonongeka.

interface.subtitle: Pangani Novera kukhala yanu, kuyambira mawonekedwe ake mpaka zokonda zanu.
interface.accentColorDesc: Sankhani kamvekedwe ka mawu ndi mtundu wam'mbali.
interface.title: Chiyankhulo
interface.fontSizeDesc: Sinthani kukula kwa zilembo za pulogalamuyi.
interface.notificationPositionDesc: Pomwe zidziwitso za toast zimawonekera. Pa Windows, zokhazikika ndizotsika kumanja kotero kuti ma popups samaphimba zowongolera zenera.
interface.showTokenSpeedDesc: Onetsani ma tokeni/masekondi ndi ma tokeni owerengera pamzere pansipa mauthenga othandizira. Ikathimitsidwa, chithunzi chophatikizika chimawonetsa zambiri pakudina.
interface.coloredUserBubbleDesc: Gwiritsani ntchito mtundu wa mawu ngati maziko a mauthenga anu. Akazimitsa, amafananiza mauthenga othandizira omwe ali ndi mawu osamveka bwino.
interface.renderHtmlArtifactsDesc: Onjezani tabu yowoneratu ku HTML ndi SVG zotchinga. HTML imayendetsa tsamba lachitsanzo mu sandboxed frame yomwe imagwiritsa ntchito zolembedwa zake koma osatha kupeza Novera, mafayilo anu, kapena netiweki; SVG amawonetsa mokhazikika ndi zolembedwa zoyimitsidwa. Kuzimitsa mwachisawawa.
interface.autoGenerateTitleDesc: Onjezani mwachidule zokambirana zatsopano kukhala mutu wa ulusi. Zimitsani kuti musunge mutu wokhazikika mpaka mutautchanso nokha.
interface.windowBackgroundDesc: Khazikitsani mtundu wakumbuyo wazenera la pulogalamuyi.
interface.appMainViewDesc: Khazikitsani mtundu wakumbuyo wa zomwe zili mkati.
interface.primaryDesc: Khazikitsani mtundu woyambira wa kamvekedwe ka mawonekedwe.
interface.accentDesc: Sankhani mtundu wa mawu omwe amagwiritsidwa ntchito pa UI.
interface.resetToDefaultDesc: Bwezerani zosintha zonse za mawonekedwe kuti zikhale zokhazikika.
interface.threadScrollDesc: Sankhani momwe malo ochezera amayenera kuchita mauthenga atsopano akafika.
interface.threadScrollFlowHint: Imasunga malo owonera uthenga watsopano womwe mumatumiza.
interface.threadScrollStickyHint: Imatsatira zokha mayankho akuyenderera mu nthawi yeniyeni.
interface.tokenCounterCompactDesc: Onetsani kauntala mkati mwa macheza. Ikayimitsidwa, kauntala ya ma tokeni imawonekera pansi pa zomwe zalowetsedwa.
interface.showLineNumbersDesc: Onetsani manambala amizere pama block block.
interface.resetCodeBlockStyleDesc: Bwezeretsani kalembedwe ka code block kukhala kusakhazikika.
interface.resetCodeBlockSuccess: Kusintha kalembedwe ka code block kuyambiranso bwino
interface.resetCodeBlockSuccessDesc: Mawonekedwe a code block abwezeretsedwa kukhala osakhazikika.

hardware.name: Dzina
hardware.enableVulkanDesc: Gwiritsani ntchito Vulkan API kuti GPU mathamangitsidwe. Osatsegula Vulkan ngati muli ndi NVIDIA GPU chifukwa zingayambitse zovuta zina.
hardware.noDevicesDesc: Palibe ma GPU omwe amawonekera ku injini ya llama.cpp. Mitundu idzayendetsedwa pa CPU.
hardware.backendApiDesc: Momwe llama.cpp amalankhula ndi izi GPU
hardware.unifiedMemoryDesc: GPU imagawana mpumulo umodzi ndi CPU - mitundu imachokera pamtima womwewo ndi makina onse.
hardware.engineRestartedForDevices: Ma GPU anu adasintha, motero injini yakomweko idayambikanso. Mitundu imayambiranso mukagwiritsidwa ntchito mtsogolo.
hardware.engineBusyDevicesChanged: Ma GPU anu asintha, koma mtundu uli wotanganidwa. Imitsani, kenako dinani Refresh kuti mugwiritse ntchito GPU yatsopano.

httpsProxy.proxyUrlDesc: URL ndi doko la seva yanu yoyimira.
httpsProxy.authenticationDesc: Zidziwitso za seva ya proxy, ngati pakufunika.
httpsProxy.noProxyDesc: Mndandanda wosiyanitsidwa ndi koma wa olandila kuti alambalale proxy.
httpsProxy.ignoreSslDesc: Lolani ziphaso zodzilembera nokha kapena zosatsimikizika. Izi zitha kufunikira kwa ma proxies ena koma zimachepetsa chitetezo. Yambitsani kokha ngati mukukhulupirira projekiti yanu.
httpsProxy.proxySslDesc: Tsimikizirani chiphaso cha SSL mukamalumikizana ndi projekiti.
httpsProxy.proxyHostSslDesc: Tsimikizirani chiphaso cha SSL cha woyang'anira projekiti.
httpsProxy.peerSslDesc: Tsimikizirani ma satifiketi a SSL ogwirizana ndi anzanu.
httpsProxy.hostSslDesc: Tsimikizirani ziphaso za SSL za olandira alendo.

webSearch.title: Kusaka pa intaneti
webSearch.description: Lolani zitsanzo zifufuze ndikuwerenga intaneti pogwiritsa ntchito zida zomangira za Novera.
webSearch.enableDesc: Salitsani zida za web_search ndi web_fetch kumamodeli omwe amathandizira kugwiritsa ntchito zida. Imagwira ntchito popanda kiyi ya API.
webSearch.providerDesc: Sankhani kumbuyo komwe kumayankha web_search ndi web_fetch.
webSearch.apiKeyOptional: Mwasankha. Perekani kiyi ya {{provider}} API kuti mukhale ndi malire apamwamba komanso zotsatira zosanjidwa. Siyani opanda kanthu kuti mugwiritse ntchito makiyi aulere.
webSearch.apiKeyRequired: Chofunika. {{provider}} ikufunika kiyi ya API kuti mubweze zotsatira.
webSearch.endpointDesc: Chofunika. Zoyambira URL za {{provider}} mwachitsanzo, ndi JSON API woyatsa.

cowork.title: Cowork
cowork.description: Konzani malo a Cowork: chipolopolo chake cha sandbox, kuphatikiza kukumbukira ndi luso lomwe limasungidwa mufoda yanu ya Novera.
cowork.shellSandboxed: Malamulo amayendetsedwa ndi {{backend}}: amatha kulemba mkati mwa gawo logwirira ntchito, ndipo mafayilo omwe ali mufoda yanu yanyumba sawerengeka.
cowork.shellUnavailable: Palibe sandbox yomwe ilipo pamakinawa, kotero chida cha chipolopolo sichimaperekedwa. Malamulo samayendetsedwa popanda malire.
cowork.networkDesc: Lolani kuti malamulo a Cowork afike pa netiweki, pa zinthu monga kuyika ma phukusi kapena kutenga malo. Yachitika mwachisawawa. Chipolopolo chachikulu cha macheza sichikhala ndi intaneti.
cowork.noMemories: Palibe zokumbukira pano. Ma Model amawawonjezera ndi chida cha memory_write akamaphunzira zinthu zofunika kuzisunga.
cowork.noSkills: Palibe luso pano. Luso ndi malangizo ogwiritsidwanso ntchito omwe chitsanzo chingathe kunyamula pakufunika.
cowork.editMemoryDesc: Mutu umodzi pa noti iliyonse. Ma Model amawerenganso izi ndi chida cha memory_read.
cowork.editSkillDesc: Markdown malangizo, osasankha okhala ndi mafotokozedwe mu YAML frontmatter. Kufotokozera ndi zomwe zitsanzo zimawona zisanayambe kukweza luso.

localApiServer.title: Seva Yapafupi API
localApiServer.serverLogsDesc: Onani zolemba zatsatanetsatane za seva yapafupi ya API.
localApiServer.runOnStartupDesc: Yambitsani zokha Seva Yapafupi ya API pulogalamu ikakhazikitsidwa.
localApiServer.runInBackgroundDesc: Sungani seva ikuyenda mu tray system pomwe zenera latsekedwa. Mukazimitsa, kutseka zenera kumasiya Novera ndikuyimitsa seva.
localApiServer.serverPortDesc: Nambala ya doko ya seva ya API.
localApiServer.apiPrefixDesc: Chiyambi cha njira cha API zomaliza.
localApiServer.apiKeyDesc: Tsimikizirani zopempha ndi kiyi ya API.
localApiServer.trustedHostsDesc: Olandira amaloledwa kulowa pa seva, olekanitsidwa ndi koma.
localApiServer.corsDesc: Lolani zopempha zochokera ku seva ya API.
localApiServer.verboseLogsDesc: Yambitsani zipika zatsatanetsatane za seva kuti zithetse.
localApiServer.proxyTimeoutDesc: Nthawi yodikirira yankho lachitsanzo chapafupi, masekondi.
localApiServer.defaultModelDesc: Mtundu wakumaloko kuti uzitsegula zokha seva ikayamba.

privacy.helpUsImproveDesc: Kuti mutithandize kukonza Novera, mutha kugawana nawo data yosadziwika monga momwe zimagwiritsidwira ntchito komanso kuchuluka kwa ogwiritsa ntchito. Sitisonkhanitsa macheza kapena zambiri zanu.
privacy.privacyPolicy: Muli ndi mphamvu zonse pazambiri zanu. Dziwani zambiri mu Mfundo Zazinsinsi.
privacy.analyticsDesc: Kuti tiwongolere Novera, tikuyenera kumvetsetsa momwe imagwiritsidwira ntchito—koma ndi thandizo lanu. Mutha kusintha zochunirazi nthawi iliyonse.
privacy.privacyPromises: Zomwe mungasankhe pano sizisintha malonjezo athu achinsinsi:
privacy.promise1: Zokambirana zanu zimakhala zachinsinsi komanso pazida zanu
privacy.promise2: Sititenga zambiri zanu kapena zomwe mumacheza
privacy.promise4: Mutha kutuluka nthawi iliyonse osataya magwiridwe antchito
privacy.promise5: Ndife owonekera pazomwe timasonkhanitsa komanso chifukwa chake

attachments.subtitle: Konzani zomata zikalata, kukula kwake, ndi machitidwe obweza.
attachments.enableDesc: Lolani kukweza ndi kusanja zikalata kuti mutengenso.

attachments.autoInlineThresholdDesc: Kagawo kakang'ono kachitsanzo komwe amagwiritsidwa ntchito ngati njira yodulira mafayilo osankhidwa amitundu yakwanuko.

attachments.chunkSizeDesc: Chifupifupi zilembo zosachepera pagawo lililonse pazoyika.
